tools.name: show_speed_reader
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to practice reading supplied text one word at a time. Accepts up to 20,000 characters, 100 to 1,000 words per minute, and 1 to 4 words per flash. Returns the word count and scheduled reading time; it is a training aid and does not measure comprehension.

tools.name: estimate_reading_time
tools.description: Use this when the user needs a reading-time or speaking-time estimate from text or a word count. Accepts text up to 20,000 characters or 1 to 2,000,000 words, plus 100 to 1,000 wpm or a reader type. Returns a 150 to 800 wpm table; it does not assess reading ability.

tools.name: run_reading_speed_test
tools.description: Use this when the user wants an original timed reading-speed practice test with comprehension questions. Accepts short, medium, or long passages only. Returns the passage length and four multiple-choice questions with four options each; correct options stay in widget-only metadata. Do not use for me
